hints.title: Sort Both Strings
hints.text: Sort the characters of s1 and s2 in ascending alphabetical order.

hints.title: Positional Domination
hints.text: String s1 breaks s2 if sorted s1[i] >= sorted s2[i] for all i. String s2 breaks s1 if sorted s2[i] >= sorted s1[i] for all i.

hints.title: Check Either Condition
hints.text: Return true if either s1 breaks s2 or s2 breaks s1 across all character indices.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of strings s1 and s2
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all N! permutations of both strings is impossible for N up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting aligns the smallest to largest characters, which gives the best chance to dominate position by position.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts both strings and verifies whether all pairs satisfy >= in either direction.
complexity.notes: Character frequency counting can also achieve O(N) using counting sort.

solutions.approach: sorting both strings and checking bidirectional domination
